items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 17 at 12:07AM CDT until October 17 at 7:00AM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Gale Warning, north winds 20 to 30 knots with
gusts up to 40 knots and rough waters. For the Small Craft
Advisory, north winds 20 to 25 knots with gusts up to 30 knots
and rough waters expected.

* WHERE...Baffin Bay and Upper Laguna Madre, Corpus Christi and
Nueces Bays, Copano, Aransas, and Redfish Bays and San
Antonio, Mesquite, and Espiritu Santo Bays.

* WHEN...For the Gale Warning, until 7 AM CDT this morning. For
the Small Craft Advisory, from 7 AM this morning to 1 PM CDT
this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Gale force winds and high seas will result in
dangerous marine conditions which could result in capsized or
damaged vessels.
items.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 17 at 12:07AM CDT until October 17 at 1:00PM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Gale Warning, north winds 20 to 30 knots with
gusts up to 40 knots and seas 8 to 13 feet. For the Small Craft
Advisory, north winds 20 to 25 knots and seas 7 to 10 feet
expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Baffin Bay to Port Aransas out 20
NM, Coastal waters from Port Aransas to Matagorda Ship Channel
out 20 NM, Waters from Baffin Bay to Port Aransas from 20 to
60 NM and Waters from Port Aransas to Matagorda Ship Channel
from 20 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...For the Gale Warning, until 1 PM CDT this afternoon.
For the Small Craft Advisory, from 1 PM this afternoon to 1 AM
CDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gale force winds and high seas will result in
dangerous marine conditions which could result in capsized or
damaged vessels.
